slots.notes: Fullscreen muted autoplay looping hero background video, absolute inset-0 object-cover z-0 behind the centered hero content.

mechanic: A 100vh non-scrolling navbar+hero where a fullscreen muted looping background video sits behind centered Instrument-Serif copy and CTAs that fade-rise in on staggered Framer Motion delays, above a fully React-coded frosted-glass SaaS dashboard preview that fade-rises last and is clipped by the viewport's overflow-hidden.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS (config extends fontFamily display/body to CSS vars; HSL design tokens in index.css) with tailwindcss-animate, framer-motion for staggered fade-up animations, lucide-react icons, and a shadcn/ui Button component; the dashboard chart is a hand-crafted cubic Bézier SVG path, not a charting library.
reskinNotes: The accent indigo (239 84% 67%) is baked into the inline SVG area-chart stroke and its linear-gradient fill stops, so reskinning the accent requires editing the chart SVG, not just a token swap. The frosted-glass dashboard wrapper uses hardcoded inline rgba(255,255,255,0.4) background and rgba(255,255,255,0.5) border plus the --shadow-dashboard rgba shadow, which assume a light/white scene and won't adapt to a dark or colored brand. Layout is tuned to Instrument-Serif metrics (leading-[0.95], tight tracking, lg:text-[5rem]) and to the headline's inline italic emphasis word ('Smarter'), which is a hardcoded per-word span in markup. Light-mode only (no dark theme). Extensive dashboard copy (brand 'Nexora', greeting 'Welcome, Jane', avatar 'JB', account names/amounts, transaction rows, GPT-5 badge text) and all CTA/nav labels are hardcoded in the JSX. The dashboard is deliberately coded markup rather than a fillable image asset, so its visuals can only be reskinned in code.
